description: Query the public ClinicalTrials.gov v2 registry without a login, cookie or proxy. Choose a sponsor, trial-site location or NCT-ID lookup, or search by condition, intervention, title, outcome, study ID or facility. Narrow by recruitment status, study type, phase, eligibility, funder, documents, results, enrollment and dates, then page to as many as 10,000 matching studies.

ageGroups.description: Keep studies that enroll any of the selected age groups. Empty = no age-group filter.
ageGroups.title: Age groups

ageRangeFrom.description: Keep studies whose eligibility age window overlaps this lower bound, expressed in `ageRangeUnit` (years by default). Studies with no age limit are treated as 0-120 years.
ageRangeFrom.title: Age range — from (years)

ageRangeTo.description: Keep studies whose eligibility age window overlaps this upper bound, expressed in `ageRangeUnit`.
ageRangeTo.title: Age range — to (years)

completionDateFrom.description: Drop studies whose completion date is before this date.
completionDateFrom.title: Study completion — from

completionDateTo.description: Drop studies whose completion date is after this date.
completionDateTo.title: Study completion — to

conditionQuery.description: Disease, condition, or medical term (e.g. `diabetes`, `breast cancer`, `Alzheimer disease`).
conditionQuery.title: Condition / disease (mode=byCondition)

containsKeyword.description: Client-side filter: keep only records whose title, summary, eligibility, conditions, keywords, or interventions contain this substring (case-insensitive).
containsKeyword.title: Contains keyword

country.description: Keep studies with a trial location in this country.
country.title: Country

countryText.description: Any country name, including countries not in the dropdown. Takes precedence over `country`.
countryText.title: Country name (any)

documentTypes.description: Keep studies that have any of these documents posted. Empty = no document filter.
documentTypes.title: Study documents

enrollmentFrom.description: Drop studies whose planned or actual enrollment is below this number.
enrollmentFrom.title: Enrollment — minimum

enrollmentTo.description: Drop studies whose planned or actual enrollment is above this number.
enrollmentTo.title: Enrollment — maximum

fdaRegulated.description: Keep studies that are FDA-regulated drug or device trials. Empty = no filter.
fdaRegulated.title: FDA-regulated

firstPostedDateFrom.description: Drop studies first posted before this date.
firstPostedDateFrom.title: First posted — from

firstPostedDateTo.description: Drop studies first posted after this date.
firstPostedDateTo.title: First posted — to

healthyVolunteersFilter.description: Keep studies that do or do not accept healthy volunteers. Empty = no filter.
healthyVolunteersFilter.title: Accepts healthy volunteers

includeResults.description: When enabled, add a compact `results` object (participant-flow/baseline group counts, outcome-measure counts and a 5-item sample, adverse-event counts, limitations) for studies with posted results.
includeResults.title: Include posted results summary

interventionQuery.description: Drug name, device, biological, or therapy (e.g. `metformin`, `pembrolizumab`, `CAR-T`).
interventionQuery.title: Intervention / drug (mode=byIntervention)

interventionTypes.description: Keep studies with any of the selected intervention types. Empty = no intervention-type filter.
interventionTypes.title: Intervention types

lastUpdatePostedDateFrom.description: Drop studies last updated before this date.
lastUpdatePostedDateFrom.title: Last update posted — from

lastUpdatePostedDateTo.description: Drop studies last updated after this date.
lastUpdatePostedDateTo.title: Last update posted — to

locationQuery.description: Geographic location text (city, state, country) — e.g. `Boston`, `California`, `United States`.
locationQuery.title: Location (mode=byLocation)

nctIds.description: List of NCT identifiers like `NCT04280705`. Full URLs (`https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT...`) are also accepted.
nctIds.title: NCT IDs (mode=byNctIds)

onlyFdaaaViolations.description: When enabled, keep only studies with an FDAAA 801 violation.
onlyFdaaaViolations.title: FDAAA 801 violations only

onlyPatientRegistries.description: When enabled, keep only studies flagged as patient registries.
onlyPatientRegistries.title: Patient registries only

outcomeQuery.description: Words from a primary or secondary outcome measure (e.g. `quality of life`, `progression-free survival`).
outcomeQuery.title: Outcome measure (mode=byOutcome)

phases.description: Keep studies in any of the selected trial phases. Empty = no phase filter.
phases.title: Phases

primaryCompletionDateFrom.description: Drop studies whose primary completion date is before this date.
primaryCompletionDateFrom.title: Primary completion — from

primaryCompletionDateTo.description: Drop studies whose primary completion date is after this date.
primaryCompletionDateTo.title: Primary completion — to

resultsAvailability.description: Keep studies with or without posted results. Empty = no filter.
resultsAvailability.title: Study results

resultsFirstPostedDateFrom.description: Drop studies whose results were first posted before this date.
resultsFirstPostedDateFrom.title: Results first posted — from

resultsFirstPostedDateTo.description: Drop studies whose results were first posted after this date.
resultsFirstPostedDateTo.title: Results first posted — to

searchQuery.description: Free-text query against the full study record. Used by mode=search; also serves as a fallback for the other browse modes if their specific query is empty.
searchQuery.title: Search query (mode=search)

sex.description: Restrict by the sex a study enrolls. `ALL` keeps only studies open to both sexes; `MALE`/`FEMALE` keep studies open to that sex (including both-sex studies).
sex.title: Eligible sex

sort.description: Order of the results returned by ClinicalTrials.gov.
sort.title: Sort by

sponsorClass.description: Keep studies by lead-sponsor class. Empty = no funder filter.
sponsorClass.title: Funder type

sponsorQuery.description: Lead sponsor or collaborator name. Use `sponsorScope` to choose which one. Exact registered names work best (e.g. `Pfizer Inc.`, `Mayo Clinic`); partial names usually still match.
sponsorQuery.title: Sponsor (mode=bySponsor)

sponsorScope.description: Match `sponsorQuery` against the lead sponsor only or against lead sponsor plus collaborators.
sponsorScope.title: Sponsor scope

startDateFrom.description: Drop studies that started before this date. ISO 8601 partial dates accepted (e.g. `2020`, `2020-01`, `2020-01-15`).
startDateFrom.title: Study start — from

startDateTo.description: Drop studies that started after this date.
startDateTo.title: Study start — to

startUrl.description: Paste a study URL (`https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT...`), a search-results URL, or an `https://clinicaltrials.gov/api/v2/studies?...` URL. Values in the URL take precedence over the matching input fields; the remaining filters still apply.
startUrl.title: Start from a ClinicalTrials.gov URL

state.description: Trial-site state or region as registered on ClinicalTrials.gov (e.g. `California`, `Ontario`). Exact name, not a two-letter code.
state.title: State / region

statuses.description: Keep studies with any of the selected statuses. Empty = no status filter.
statuses.title: Recruitment / overall status

studyIdQuery.description: The sponsor's own study identifier (e.g. `20-0006`, `SC2900`). Exact identifier only.
studyIdQuery.title: Sponsor study ID (mode=byStudyId)

studyTypes.description: Keep studies of any of the selected types. Empty = no study-type filter.
studyTypes.title: Study type

titleQuery.description: Words from the brief title, official title or acronym (e.g. `remdesivir`, `ACTT`).
titleQuery.title: Title / acronym (mode=byTitle)

title: ClinicalTrials.gov Sponsor, Location & NCT Lookup Input
